message: The "J" prefix is being used with a <chip />, try using it with a <connector /> or <jumper />
J1 has no pin with requires_power=true
J1 has no pin with requires_ground=true
All pins on J1 are underspecified (no pinAttributes set)

J1 is inferred to face x- from its cable insertion center because no explicit footprint insertionDirection is defined, but should face y- so the connector is accessible from the board edge. Set insertionDirection on the <footprint> to specify the actual direction in the footprint's unrotated orientation; for example, <footprint insertionDirection="from_above"> for a connector accessed from above the PCB (+Z).
J1 may not have availability from jlcpcb (C5815189).
